sentences: You'd better slow down before you burn out.
If I were you, I'd talk to a therapist about this.
She had better learn to relax more often.
If I were you, I wouldn't ignore the signs of stress.
He'd better take a deep breath before the meeting.
If I were her, I would seek help immediately.
You'd better practice mindfulness every morning.
If I were you, I'd take some time off to rest.

grammar.title: Advice — Had Better & If I Were You
rules: "had better + verbo base" dá um conselho forte, quase um aviso: You'd better rest today.
"If I were you, I'd..." expressa conselho hipotético e empático: If I were you, I'd see a doctor.
Forma negativa de had better: "had better not": You'd better not skip therapy sessions.
"If I were you" pode ser seguido de "I wouldn't" para desaconselhar algo: If I were you, I wouldn't ignore it.

rows: You had better not ignore stress.
If I were you, I'd talk to someone.
If I were you, I wouldn't...
If I were you, I wouldn't skip sleep.
